findings.title: Unknown/incompatible BIM↔CWICR units convert at 1.0; estimate_from_qto forces m³ → 1000× cost overbill
findings.description: BIMCostEstimator.estimate_element converts caller/QTO quantity into the CWICR match unit via _convert_units, then multiplies by unit_price into CostLineItem.total_cost and the official Excel from generate_estimate_report. _convert_units only knows six identical-or-imperial pairs and returns conversions.get(key, 1.0) for everything else — including mm→m (Revit lengths) and m³→m². Separately, estimate_from_qto (used by estimate_from_bim_model Quick Start) hardcodes quantity_unit="m³" for every row regardless of category, so doors/walls/pipe QTOs are forced through the same fail-open converter. Known pairs such as ft²→m² still convert, so only the missing/incompatible path is broken.
findings.impact: Official BIM→CWICR estimate Excel overstates quantities and totals. 12 m of pipe exported as 12000 mm at $65/m becomes $780,000 instead of $780. Owner GMP, bids, and pay-app baselines follow that estimate.
findings.attack_path:
1. Operator deploys BIMCostEstimator.estimate_from_qto / estimate_element / estimate_from_bim_model as the live cost estimate path.
2. Attacker (or honest Revit QTO) supplies lengths in mm, or any unit pair not in the six-entry table; estimate_from_qto also forces m³.
3. _convert_units misses and returns 1.0; adjusted_qty stays the raw BIM number.
4. total_cost = adjusted_qty × CWICR unit_price; generate_estimate_report writes that Total into the project Estimate.xlsx.
findings.why_not_already_reported_class: Same file already has prompt-injection (LLM decompose) and project_name path traversal only. Not the CWICR quantity-matcher skill — this is BIMCostEstimator on the Cost-Management Quick Start estimate_from_bim_model path, plus a unique hardcoded m³ force in estimate_from_qto.
findings.remediation: Fail closed on unknown or incompatible unit pairs. Add mm↔m (and mm2/mm3). Do not hardcode m³ in estimate_from_qto — map category/column to unit. Refuse Total Cost when conversion was not performed.
findings.poc_video_notes: Video not feasible — SKILL.md template Python with no product UI. Local non-destructive PoC: 12 m @$65 = $780; 12000 mm @$65 = $780,000 (1000×); ft²→m² still converts.
